headline: Samsung unveils thinnest Galaxy Tab S12 series with nearly 24-hour battery
summary: The new Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and S12+ boast ultra-slim designs, stunning AMOLED displays, and impressive battery life, starting at $1,199.99.
details: Samsung has officially launched its latest Galaxy Tab S12 series, featuring the Ultra and Plus models. The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra stands out as Samsung's thinnest tablet yet, measuring a mere 5.1mm thick, with the S12+ closely following at 5.3mm.

Both tablets sport vibrant 2X Dynamic AMOLED displays with up to 1,600 nits of brightness. The S12 Ultra offers a 14.6-inch screen with a 2960 x 1848 resolution and 120Hz refresh rate, while the S12+ features a 12.6-inch display with a 2800 x 1752 resolution and the same 120Hz refresh rate.

Powering these devices is impressive battery life, with the S12 Ultra delivering up to 23 hours and the S12+ up to 21 hours on a single charge. Both support 45W fast charging, capable of reaching 100% in just 95 minutes, though a charger is not included.

Included with both tablets is the S Pen, enhancing productivity and creativity. Additional accessories like a pro keyboard, book cover, and screen protector are available separately. For thermal management, a 3D Vapor Chamber ensures efficient cooling during demanding tasks like AI processing or video editing.
Camera specifications include a 12MP ultrawide front camera on both models. The S12 Ultra is equipped with a 13MP main rear camera and an 8MP ultrawide, while the S12+ has a 13MP main rear camera.
The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra starts at $1,399.99 with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage, expandable up to 2TB. The Galaxy Tab S12+ begins at $1,199.99, also with 12GB RAM and expandable storage.

These tablets come pre-loaded with valuable software, including Adobe Photoshop, Notability, and Goodnotes, offering significant subscription benefits. Users also get discounts on LumaFusion and trials for Google AI Pro.
Samsung is backing the new tablets with a commitment to seven generations of OS upgrades and seven years of security updates, ensuring long-term usability and protection.

topic: airbnb adds ai search and social features
headline_marked: Airbnb adds [[AI search]] and social map features
headline: Airbnb adds AI search and social map features
summary: The travel giant is integrating AI-powered search and a social map to help users discover properties and experiences.
details: Airbnb is rolling out a significant update focused on enhancing travel discovery through AI and social features. The platform is introducing an AI search functionality that allows users to find properties using text or voice prompts, with dynamic filters adapting to user preferences.

For example, searching for "baby" can automatically bring up filters for cribs, playgrounds, or children's books. Airbnb's AI will also provide summaries and reviews to help users compare properties on their wishlist.
Beyond AI search, Airbnb is expanding its service offerings, including meal delivery, laundry, and gear rentals in select locations, aiming to compete more directly with traditional hotels.

The company is also enhancing social features, allowing users to see travel maps based on their connections' past or upcoming trips. This feature includes an option for users to control their privacy and choose not to share their travel details.
Additionally, Airbnb is creating neighborhood pages informed by guest reviews and other sources to guide travelers on local dining and activities.

CEO Brian Chesky emphasized the careful approach to AI integration, stating that the current AI search is just the beginning and will be iterated upon rapidly. He highlighted the challenge of implementing AI search in e-commerce without negatively impacting conversion rates.
